description: Transformer temperature monitor and tap changer voltage regulator: oil and winding temperatures, ageing, cooling, OLTC differential, tap position, regulation sets, alarms and tap changer maintenance
source: Treetech TMV / SDV / SDT Mapa de Protocolos de Comunicação MAP-013, rev. 1.10

sources.title: TMV / SDV / SDT: Mapa de Protocolos de Comunicação (MAP-013, planilha)
sources.note: sheet Full Map (Modbus); linked in issue #155

notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485, FC01 to FC06, FC15 and FC16. Addresses are 0-based, as sent on the wire.

Baud rate is selectable (4800 to 115200 bit/s), 8 data bits, no parity, 1 or 2 stop bits (detected automatically). The document gives no factory default for the baud rate or the address; 9600 and 1 are assumed here.

The document is a spreadsheet that lists engineering ranges, not raw ranges. Scales are taken from ranges that have decimals (for example -99.9 to 999.9 is tenths). For the VT voltage, CT current, frequency, power factor and load percentage the range is whole numbers, and the scale is taken from the AVR document, which lists the same registers with larger raw ranges; check these against the display.

Left out: the SPS node blocks (holding 600 to 2313, discrete 600 to 2310), the relay association coils, the hot-spot factor and 2M exponent settings and the paper moisture settings (their scales are not clear), the 48-bit timestamps, the tap changer rated current (21305) and the squared-current limits in 21404 to 21408.

Registers 500 to 507 and the bank/transformer blocks only apply when the device is set up as a parallelism concentrator. Winding 2 and 3 values only apply when the device has that many windings (holding 10202).
The document applies to firmware 1.11 R22. Written from that document; this map has not been tested on a device.
